scalars.scalar_value: A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration, or a related field is required.

items.item_text: A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration, or a related field is required.

A minimum of three to seven years of progressively responsible experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, or analytical roles, preferably within higher education, nonprofit, or complex institutional environments.

Working with the AVPF and Directors within the Business Office, coordinate the annual all‑funds operating budget development process, including timeline management, campus outreach, data collection, validation, and consolidation.
Maintain detailed financial models supporting tuition revenue, enrollment room and board, compensation, financial aid, endowment spending, and other core budget drivers.
Work closely with campus departments to develop, review, and refine budget submissions, ensuring alignment with institutional priorities and financial policies.
Support academic and administrative departments during the budget and forecast cycle.
Coordinate timelines, deliverables, and approvals across multiple stakeholders to ensure completion of budget milestones.
Develop and maintain budget process documentation, templates, and guidance materials.
Serve as system administrator for Anaplan, the Colleges budget development and forecasting system.
Prepare budget materials, schedules, and analyses for review by senior leadership and presentation to the Finance and Operations Committee and Board of Trustees.
Support ongoing budget oversight through regular monitoring of budget‑to‑actual performance and preparation of forecasts throughout the fiscal year.
Maintain and update capital budgets and multi‑year capital forecasts in coordination with Campus Planning and Finance leadership.
Track approved capital projects, expenditures, and funding sources; reconcile capital spending to budgets and forecasts.
Prepare capital budget summaries and reporting for internal leadership and Board review.
Assist with capital reserve forecasting and equipment replacement planning.
Support review of major project cost reports and construction‑in‑progress tracking.
Review and support analysis of the College’s debt portfolio and capital reserve program.
Develop and maintain short‑ and long‑range financial forecasts and scenario models, including multi‑year projections.
Prepare periodic forecast updates reflecting changes in enrollment, compensation, capital activity, or other key assumptions.
Analyze trends, variances, and risks, and summarize implications clearly for leadership decision‑making.
Develop and maintain forecasting models for enrollment, cash, and other key areas, as needed.
Support ad‑hoc financial modeling and analysis related to strategic initiatives and planning efforts.
Develop and maintain financial reports in Workday (Enterprise Resource Planning) and Anaplan (planning tool) to support budget monitoring and forecasting.
Ensure integrity, consistency, and documentation of financial data and assumptions.
Participate in the implementation and enhancement of financial systems, including planning, reporting, and analytics tools.
Support audit and compliance activities as they relate to budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning and reporting.
Prepare and respond to internal and external financial data requests and surveys as related to budgeting and planning.
Perform other duties and projects as assigned.
Strong proficiency in various accounting software systems and Microsoft Excel.
Strong proficiency in general ledger accounting, understanding of financial statements and internal control functions.
Strong analytic and research skills required. Ability to exercise a high degree of accurate and independent judgment, tact and discretion.
Ability to work well with diverse College constituents in a team-oriented environment. Excellent organizational and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects.
Ability to prepare and present various analytical materials, including trend analysis and fiscal projections.
